patch_description:
This crossover ansatz keeps the efficient 12-parameter-per-block budget of the stronger shared-parameter design, while importing the broader candidate’s idea of mixed controlled-rotation entanglers. The block uses:
- mirrored shared RY pre-rotations for stable feature lifting,
- a fixed CZ scaffold to add regularizing entanglement at zero parameter cost,
- a small mixed-axis controlled-rotation core (CRX/CRY/CRZ) for expressive nonlinear mixing,
- mirrored shared RZ post-rotations to refine readout-sensitive phases.

The result preserves the same training loop and I/O, but should reduce overfitting relative to the larger ansatz while retaining enough expressivity for fast convergence.
